# `missing-resource-cleanup`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: quick fix · Options: none

Reports a recognized resource or mutex with no visible cleanup, unlock, or
ownership transfer on some path, and a mutex unlocked twice.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

File handles, clients, containers, and locks often retain memory or system state
even when no raw allocation is visible.

## When it fires

It applies to known constructor/cleanup pairs and lock scopes. Locks include
`lock()` and the `std.Io` forms `lock(io)`, `lockUncancelable(io)` and their
shared variants; a `try` or `return error.X` between a lock and its unlock leaves
the mutex locked, and a second plain unlock, or one after `defer unlock`, unlocks
it twice. Only returning, storing or passing the handle itself transfers it:
`_ = file;` and `return try file.readPositionalAll(...)` do not, while views such
as `file.reader(...)` keep it. Assigning a new resource to a binding declared
outside a loop, with no release or transfer in the loop body, leaks the previous
one on every iteration.

Managed values include `std.Io.Writer.Allocating`, also when declared as
`var out: std.Io.Writer.Allocating = .init(gpa)`; returning `out.written()` only
borrows its bytes, while `out.toOwnedSlice()` hands them on.

Cleanup of every resource-owning aggregate field satisfies the contract; custom
ownership conventions require explicit project policy or code. An arena created
in `pub fn main` lives until the process exits, managed memory from an arena
(directly or through a `const allocator = arena.allocator();` alias) or a fixed
buffer is released with it, and managed memory in a `test` block is checked by
`std.testing.allocator`, so none of them needs a visible `deinit`.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn save(directory: anytype) !void {
    const file = try directory.openFile("state", .{});
    try file.writeAll("ready");
}
```
